visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of raw beef slices with white marbling being placed on a black metal grill using tongs. A female staff member wearing a navy blue uniform with a branded logo on the sleeve places a silver platter of meat and zucchini slices onto a wooden table. The indoor restaurant environment features light wood accents and warm, bright lighting. (2) Chronological close-up shots showcase several prepared dishes: a thick slice of golden-brown caramelized French toast on a silver plate, a tall glass filled with pink strawberry milk, and a bubbling stone pot of spicy red tofu soup garnished with green onions. A hand is seen using chopsticks to mix a bowl of rice topped with a raw egg yolk and shredded golden garnish. (3) The focus returns to the grilling process, showing several cuts of marbled beef sizzling on the grill rack. A platter of pork slices is displayed, followed by a bowl of rice topped with green onions, fried garlic, and seaweed. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the textures of the food and the polished surfaces of the tableware. (4) In the final phase, a spoon scoops creamy white panna cotta from a small glass jar. The camera pans out to show several customers seated at a long wooden dining counter under black industrial ventilation pipes. The video ends with a daytime outdoor shot of the restaurant's white exterior and its vertical 'Kohola' signage under a clear sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy male narrator speaking Mandarin with a bright, enthusiastic tone. Underneath, a high-tempo electronic pop track plays with a steady 4/4 drum machine beat and bright synthesizer pads. A distinct sizzling sound effect of meat on a grill is mixed prominently to emphasize the visual action. (2) As the narrator describes various menu items, his speech rate remains fast and continuous with high pitch variability. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat energy. Faint restaurant room tone and the subtle clink of ceramic tableware are audible in the background, providing an authentic setting feel without obscuring the primary narration. (3) The music continues as the main layer of the background, featuring rhythmic synth pulses. The narrator's voice rises in pitch when introducing the desserts, signaling excitement. The overall mix is clean and professionally balanced, with the vocals sitting clearly above the instrumentation and environmental sounds. (4) The final segment features a signature vocal sign-off from the narrator with high emotional valence. The electronic BGM sustains its volume through the closing seconds, ending with a clean hard cut that aligns with the visual transition to the shop's exterior and logo.
